say:1:1322433001:1.text: Didn't expect you to dig up clues this fast.
say:1:1322433001:1.source_cn: 没想到你们这么迅速就查到线索了。

say:2:1322433002:1.text: These cultists have already started holding gatherings. We need to act fast and come up with a plan.
say:2:1322433002:1.source_cn: 这群邪教徒已经开始组织礼拜，我们得尽快了解情况，制定对策。

say:3:1322433003:1.text: I'll have my people look into the timing of their gatherings. As soon as we find anything, I'll let you know.
say:3:1322433003:1.source_cn: 我会派人调查邪教徒举行礼拜的规律，一旦找到新的线索我会...
